title: The oracle as a precisely defined operation
objectives: Define a Boolean oracle on every basis state.
Translate simple truth tables into gate circuits.
prerequisites: Chapters 3–6: tensor products, unitary gates, joint-state order, coherent control and measurement.

quizzes.question: Which two-input truth table represents parity x1⊕x0 in order 00,01,10,11?
feedback: Correct: the output is one when exactly one input bit is one.
That is the left input bit x1.

quizzes.question: Does an oracle-query count include the full physical cost of building Uf?
options: No; implementation and data-access costs require separate analysis.
feedback: Query complexity treats calls through a stated interface.
Correct: resource models must be kept explicit.
A black-box model is not a physical implementation.
